_comment: Rows of harness/captures/out2/part_database.json excluded from the capture.part_database gate, one by one, each with its reason (README "Golden gate options", STATUS.md WP-06). Only data that a package other than the module host produces belongs here.

module_fields.reason: ModuleDeployablePart.cs:542 OnAwake: panelRotationTransform = part.FindModelTransform(pivotName); originalRotation = currentRotation = its localRotation. The value is the pivot transform's rotation inside the part's .mu model (UE import pipeline / PartTools reader), not GameData cfg data; parts without a pivot keep the Quaternion default (0,0,0,0) and are gated
